privacy: Only operational results. Private images and generated recordings were used locally and are excluded, along with filenames, pixel arrays and facial coordinates.
environment: Desktop Chromium via T3 preview and Aside REPL; no physical phone benchmark

camera.source: Browser canvas MediaStream from a locally supplied portrait; not physical hardware

limitations: This is functional verification, not pixel parity with TikTok or a controlled speed benchmark.
CPU segmentation makes live processing slower; smooth real-time independent retouching is not established.
A separate numerical test covers the mask and quadratic blending; tracker disagreement is documented separately.
